description: Contract for the mDNS service TXT record. All values are strings (mDNS encoding). Generated from hsync_common.protocol.schemas.

connected.description: Count of clients currently connected to this bucket's share (master included). Present only on a serving master; informational, never part of the election.

heartbeat.description: Monotonic liveness counter, incremented on every periodic re-announce. Opaque: receivers only rely on it changing so their staleness sweep sees fresh records for otherwise quiescent peers. Never part of the election.

inbound.description: This node has a confirmed externally dialable data-plane endpoint (e.g. a successful UPnP mapping), so it can serve without the relay. Part of the election: a reachable node out-ranks a relay-only one, after server_ready/prefer_master.

peer_download.description: This node serves file blocks to other peers (read-only seeder semantics, ADR-0028). Absent when block serving is disabled, even if the node still publishes its inventory.

readonly_permissions.description: This node's local filesystem can represent only the owner-write bit (Windows): permission-only comparisons are projected to it.

title: HSYNC p2p mDNS/TXT record (p2p/1)
